title: vivo Y600 is official with a 10,000mAh battery and 6.83-inch display
description: The vivo Y600 is now available for pre-order in China, as promised, with open sales set to begin on October 30. The phone packs a massive 10,000mAh battery and has also earned a Guinness World Record for battery endurance. As per the Guinness World Records test, the phone lasted for 32 hours and 37 minutes during a continuous livestream test. The 10,000mAh battery supports 44W wired fast charging and reverse wired charging. title: Counterpoint: Global PC shipments were down 21% in Q3
description: A new Counterpoint Research report revealed that global PC shipments totaled 57 million units during the July-September period (Q3). The figure represents a 21% decline compared to the same time last year, with all major brands experiencing dwindling shipments. The main reason behind the decline lies in rising component costs, with DRAM and NAND memory chips being the main contributing factors. It’s a fun way to experience one of the most iconic Apple devices ever. The original iPod was announced on October 23, 2001 and hit store shelves on November 10 of that year. description: Last year, the Finnish company Oura sued the India-based Ultrahuman in the US over patent infringement.
